description: Add a pixel-art virtual office Team Activity page to the existing Ava HQ dashboard, showing agent workstations, real-time status, and a 76-hour activity ticker.

userStories.title: Activity API endpoint
userStories.description: As the owner, I need a backend API that returns agent status and activity history so the Team page has data to display.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/activity returns JSON matching TeamOverviewResponse schema (agents[], events[], stats, serverTime)
Scans /data/.openclaw/agents/*/sessions/*.jsonl for session data
Detects active sessions (modified within last 5 minutes) vs completed
Maps sessions to agents: main→ava, builder→builder, content→content, atlas→atlas
Returns events sorted newest-first, filtered by 'hours' query param (default 76)
Stats object includes completed, running, failed counts and avgDurationMs
Returns empty arrays gracefully if no session files exist
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Session transcripts are JSONL files. First user message in each file identifies the task. File mtime indicates last activity. Agent ID is in the directory path: /data/.openclaw/agents/{agentId}/sessions/{sessionId}.jsonl

userStories.title: Page shell with header and Team Status panel
userStories.description: As the owner, I want a Team Activity page with a live clock and a left-side status panel showing each agent's current state.
acceptanceCriteria: New page at /activity/page.tsx renders within existing Ava HQ layout
Page header shows 'Team Activity' title (text-2xl font-bold) and a live clock (HH:MM:SS, updates every second, monospace font)
Refresh button next to clock that re-fetches API data

Left panel (w-64) shows agent list: each agent has a colored status dot (green=working, yellow=idle, red=error), name in uppercase, role badge text, current task truncated to 40 chars, and duration if working
Filter toggle buttons at top of panel: ALL, WORKING, IDLE — clicking filters the agent list
Stats block at bottom of panel: Completed, Running, Failed, Avg Duration in monospace
Loading skeleton state while API fetches
Error state if API fails
Data fetched from /api/activity on mount and every 30 seconds
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow exact same patterns as other Ava HQ pages: useEffect + fetch + useState + Skeleton. The page background should be the standard bg-background from the existing theme.

userStories.title: CSS pixel art avatars
userStories.description: As the owner, I want each agent to have a unique pixel art avatar rendered in pure CSS so the office feels alive and personal.
acceptanceCriteria: PixelAvatar component at src/components/pixel-avatar.tsx
Renders a pixel character using CSS Grid (10x10 grid of colored cells)
4 unique designs: Ava (warm tones, headset), Builder (blue tones, hoodie), Content (purple tones, beret), Atlas (green tones, glasses)
Each avatar displayed at 64x64px (each cell ~6.4px)
Accepts 'status' prop: 'working' shows subtle pulse animation (CSS keyframes), 'idle' shows slightly reduced opacity (0.7), 'error' shows red tint overlay
Accepts 'agent' prop to select which design to render
Component is pure CSS — no external image assets, no canvas, no SVG
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use a 2D array of hex color strings to define each avatar. Empty cells use 'transparent'. The grid container uses CSS Grid with grid-template-columns: repeat(10, 1fr) and aspect-ratio: 1.

userStories.title: Office floor plan with agent rooms
userStories.description: As the owner, I want to see an office floor plan where each agent has their own room with desk items, and idle agents appear in the Break Room.
acceptanceCriteria: Office floor takes the main area (right of Team Status panel)
CSS Grid layout: 2x2 grid of agent rooms at top, Break Room (full width) below, Conference Room (full width) at bottom
Each agent room has: colored header bar (warm brown=Ava, blue=Builder, purple=Content, green=Atlas), agent name + role badge in pixel font, status dot, PixelAvatar component, emoji desk items row
Working agents: avatar at their desk with a speech bubble showing current task text (max 50 chars, CSS speech bubble with triangle pointer)
Idle agents: their desk room shows an empty chair emoji (🪑), avatar moves to Break Room
Break Room shows: ☕🍕🛋 decorations + all idle agent avatars in a row with their names below
Conference Room shows: 🪑🪑🪑 and text '(No active collaborations)' — placeholder for future feature
Error agents: room card border pulses red (CSS animation)
Google Font 'Press Start 2P' imported and used for room labels, agent names, and status badges only (NOT for body text)
Room cards use border and subtle shadow consistent with existing Card component styling
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Import Press Start 2P via next/font/google (same pattern as Inter in layout.tsx). Room colors should be applied as background-color with low opacity (e.g., bg-orange-950/30 for Ava) to stay readable on dark theme. Speech bubble is a simple div with relative positioning and a CSS triangle ::after pseudo-element.

userStories.title: Activity ticker bar
userStories.description: As the owner, I want a scrolling ticker at the bottom showing recent activity events so I can see what happened at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: Full-width bar fixed at bottom of the Team Activity page (not global — only on /activity)
Shows last 20 events from the API as a horizontally scrolling ticker
Each event shows: timestamp (HH:MM), agent name, message — separated by ' • '
Color coding: green text for 'complete' events, yellow for 'start', red for 'error', gray for 'info'
Auto-scrolls right-to-left using CSS animation (40s duration, linear, infinite)
Pauses animation on hover (CSS :hover pause)
Timestamp text uses monospace font
Empty state: shows 'No activity in the last 76 hours' centered
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use CSS @keyframes with translateX for scrolling. The ticker content is duplicated (rendered twice) so the scroll loops seamlessly. Ticker bar has bg-card border-t border-border to match existing theme.

userStories.title: Sidebar integration and responsive polish
userStories.description: As the owner, I want the Team page accessible from the sidebar and working well on mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: New nav item in sidebar.tsx: { href: '/activity', label: 'Team', icon: Users } — positioned after Health
Users icon imported from lucide-react
On mobile (< md breakpoint): office grid stacks to single column (1 room per row)
On mobile: Team Status panel moves above the office grid (not side-by-side)
Activity ticker remains full-width on mobile
Page loads and displays correctly at /activity
All existing pages still work (no regressions)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use responsive Tailwind classes: flex-col md:flex-row for the main layout, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 for the room grid. Test sidebar active state highlights correctly on /activity.
